title: Native ODC agents and agentic apps

capabilities.title: Create and edit native agents, tools and agentic apps in ODC
capabilities.summary: studio_create_app kind agentic creates a native Agent asset from template_Agent. studio_deliver accepts agent {data} to create/configure IAgent, model, inputs, tool handlers and structured output. Combine with logic steps node ICallAgentNode for complete service actions, branching, multiple agents, message building and explicit session memory.
capabilities.guidance: Resolve the real model connection and its action from the consumer session. For a complete agent declare purpose, system instructions in the message-building action, tools with typed inputs, return contract, memory SessionId and error behavior. agent.target patches an existing IAgent by key; omitted fields remain unchanged. Tool arguments use fromAI:true or value, exclusively. Tool descriptions edit shared action/parameter metadata. Structured output and tool calling are separate modes. ICallAgentNode is a logic node with Agent reference and args.Messages; create agents before callers. The official template provides BuildMessages_V2/LoadMemory_V2/StoreMemory_V2. Wire these into a real service action; a template clone alone has dummy calls. Example: kernel/tests/jobs-live/odc-agents-example.json. Native model tests: kernel/tests/Anvil.Tests.Odc/OdcAgentTests.cs. Delivery/publish evidence: platforms/odc/docs/AGENTES.md. Existing MCP, A2A and knowledge-base assets are not automatically created by this route. Call Agent nodes belong in server actions; expose them with a separate service action calling that server action.

limits.text: Native creation, configuration, tool metadata, identity-preserving edit, save/reload and live publishing are tested. Runtime model answers and external MCP/A2A integrations require separate execution evidence.

unavailable.reason: The native agent route imports existing AI model connections. Creation of MCP/A2A/knowledge-base assets and Agent Editor manifests is separate and is not covered by agent authoring tests.
unavailable.alternative: Discover the existing ODC connection/Portal operations and their own contracts.
